claimed_invariant: After earlier Java factories have declined the complete source, every valid DESCRIPTION element declaration is consumed by the same CommandCreateElementFull grammar and retained in one ordered entity graph. File, agent, card, stack, component, and interface declarations may coexist in any valid order and topology. LeafType and USymbol are orthogonal: most named shapes are LeafType.DESCRIPTION plus a concrete USymbol, interface is a DESCRIPTION leaf with the interface symbol, and port/portin/portout are PORTIN or PORTOUT leaf types with no ordinary USymbol. Ports are valid only inside an element group and are syntax errors at the diagram root.
causal_divergence: Rust replaced Java's one DESCRIPTION candidate with two incomplete Component and Deployment parsers, then uses keyword scores to choose between them. The b70be5ee override sees a standalone file, agent, card, or stack and forces Deployment above all competitors. That preserves the exclusive leaf but sends the entire valid source to a parser that cannot consume interface or port declarations; choosing Component has the reciprocal symbol-family loss. The resulting missing or implicitly recreated entities are caused by an absent shared grammar and AST, not by insufficient score weights. No score adjustment can make either lossy branch represent a valid mixed DESCRIPTION source.
planned_model_change: Add a canonical DescriptionDiagram AST and parser corresponding to DescriptionDiagramFactory and CommandCreateElementFull. Represent each declaration as an ordered DescriptionElement carrying id, label, semantic leaf_type, optional visual symbol, declaration kind, style metadata, owner/group, and source_line; retain containers, links, notes, together membership, declaration order, and link-created unknown leaves in the same graph. Select DESCRIPTION by complete candidate viability in Java factory order after sequence, class, and activity candidates, rather than by keyword scores or fixture-shaped routing. Parse file, agent, card, stack, component, interface, port, portin, and portout through the same command path, preserving the LeafType/USymbol distinction and returning the Java-equivalent error for a root-level port. Build one DescriptionRenderPlan from the canonical AST and dispatch paint/layout by concrete leaf_type and symbol. Existing component and deployment painters may be reused behind bounded adapters, but parser branch identity must not select the render vocabulary and no valid declaration may be dropped or synthesized as a different kind.

scope_boundary: This mechanism owns DESCRIPTION factory selection, the shared element grammar and AST, semantic validation of port ownership, and construction of a symbol-complete render plan. It does not own magnetic edge anchoring for folder shapes, painted cluster-envelope normalization, symbol-specific geometry constants, comparator behavior, baselines, or fixture eligibility.

Fresh valid nested port, portin, and portout inputs preserve PORTIN/PORTOUT semantics separately from USymbol, while root-level variants fail with the Java validity outcome instead of being ignored or rendered.
